---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or enhancement
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''

---

## 🚀 Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## 💡 Motivation / Use Case
Why is this feature useful? What problem does it solve?

**Example Scenario:**
> "As a student, I want to [do X] so that I can [achieve Y]."

## 🛠️ Proposed Implementation
(Optional) Describe how you think this feature could be implemented.

**Technical Details:**
- Which file(s) would need changes? (e.g., `vision_engine.js`, `manifest.json`)
- Would this require new permissions?
- Are there similar features in other extensions?

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered
What alternative solutions or workarounds have you considered?

## 📸 Mockups / Examples
If applicable, add mockups, diagrams, or examples from other tools.

## 🎯 Priority
How important is this feature to you?
- [ ] Critical (blocking my workflow)
- [ ] High (would significantly improve experience)
- [ ] Medium (nice to have)
- [ ] Low (future consideration)

---

**Checklist:**
- [ ] I have searched existing issues to avoid duplicates
- [ ] I have reviewed the [documentation](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) to confirm this doesn't already exist
- [ ] I am willing to contribute code if guidance is provided
